claim: The living background sound bed of a location — cicadas, birds, distant traffic, waves — which is what makes a place feel inhabited in the gaps between lines. It selects audio layers and nothing else.
not_visual: Every value in this enum names a sound, not a visible thing. Cicadas, crickets, frogs, wind chimes, distant traffic, school noise, machinery, waves and river all select an ambience stem at mix time; none of them changes a pixel of a still. A clause that drew a visible cicada or visible waves would be silently testing set dressing (world.biome, world.air_particles) under this variable's name, and the resulting panels would be evidence about the wrong control.
